status: WRITTEN preliminary all-original-pair dual-domain theorem UNREVIEWED, with independent full proof in preparation
claim: For ANY rank2 test projector P whose two local marginal supports both have dimension≤2 (including entangled/NPT P), and ANY traceless complex 4×4 A,B, Tr(PX†X)≤2L; if A² and B² are both nonnormal the inequality is strict. Thus any T2 counterexample would require at least one local marginal rank≥3, a strictly smaller original NPT test domain. This subsumes all separable and all PPT rank2 P once their earlier classifications are reviewed.
full_source_proof: Choose 2D local supports and block A=[[αI+C,A12],[A21,A22]], B=[[βI+D,B12],[B21,B22]], Tr C=Tr D=0. P input is in 2⊗2. Outputs decompose orthogonally into inside Y=(α+β)I+C⊗I+I⊗D, A21 leakage and B21 leakage. Bound inside by Tr Y†Y=4|α+β|²+2||C||²+2||D||²≤8(|α|²+|β|²)+2(C²+D²). Tracezero forces ||A22||²≥2|α|², ||B22||²≥2|β|²; leakage each ≤2||A21||²,2||B21||² because marginal PSD trace2. Remaining A12/B12 terms are nonnegative, giving full bound.
strictness: If both local marginal ranks2, their top eigenvalues are <2, so equality forces all leakage A21,B21=0 and inactive-column A12,B12=0. Complement trace-Cauchy forces A22=−αI,B22=−βI; scalar inequality forces α=β. If α=β=0, both local squares are normal. Otherwise equality inside forces rankY≤2; if C,D both nonnormal, elementary 2×2 eigenvalue/Jordan analysis gives rankY≥3, contradiction. Thus equality implies at least one local square normal. If one local rank1, P is product and the prior elementary product-projector equality gives at least one local factor normal.
limits: No claim for P with either local support rank≥3, no actual η>2L or physical/q counterexample, global T2/T3/Z2/q3, selected q/numeric/program/source/novelty.
